frozen: before activation; the first ledger entry records the SHA-256 of this file and of the code. A different file stops registration under this protocol.
scope: future eligible signals only: signal_seen_utc at or after the activation entry. Historical data never enters this ledger.

population.eligible: scangoal.eligibility.eligible(signal) is true at registration (valid odds, market and selection, verified provenance, no burst, not edited or already finished at first sight, unique match identity)
population.unit_of_registration: one record per signal key (match_id, type, market, selection), at the first collector run that sees it
population.registered_before_result: no final result known to the system at registration (bot result, bot mark or independent provider); otherwise registered with result_known_at_registration=true and excluded from every analysis

independent_result.binding: scangoal.report.external_matches on the registered fixture: exact normalized teams (or reviewed alias), compatible competition, kickoff within 15 minutes, a single provider candidate
independent_result.score: regulation time (90 minutes) only; extra time, penalties, awarded or abandoned games stay without result
independent_result.first_confirmation: the first bound provider record per provider is appended as an outcome entry; it is never replaced
independent_result.conflict: a later different score from the same provider, or providers disagreeing, is appended as outcome_conflict and the game is excluded from the primary analysis
independent_result.bot_results: never used as confirmation; reported separately for comparison
independent_result.missing: no independent result 72 hours after kickoff (or after the signal when kickoff is unknown): an outcome_missing entry; excluded from estimates and counted in every table

H1.status: primary, exploratory origin (pre-activation archive: 72.4% vs 65.9%, n=633 signals); never confirmed
H1.population: first registered eligible live signal of each game, with integer minute 0-89 and a known score at the signal, registered before any result
H1.outcome: 1 if the independent 90-minute total goals exceed the total at the signal, else 0
H1.reference: p0 = 1 - exp(-(2.7/95) * max(1, 95 - minute)): a fixed generic football rate decided before activation; it does not depend on the score
H1.control: results reported by minute band (0-29, 30-59, 60-89) and by score state (level, one-goal margin, two or more; total goals 0, 1, 2+). The reference controls minute; score is controlled by stratification, not by the reference
H1.statistic: z = (O - E) / sqrt(sum p0 (1 - p0)) over games with an independent result
H1.decision: no claim before 200 games with independent results. Above that, 'supported' only if z >= 2.576 (one-sided 0.5%) and O > E in every minute band with at least 30 games; otherwise 'not supported'. Predictive information only: not profitability
H1.limits: the reference is not a matched control and not a market price; a supported H1 says nothing about odds or ROI

H2.status: secondary. The pre-activation edge (+11.2% in discovery) did NOT replicate (+1.3% in the later check). Followed, not expected
H2.population: first registered eligible OPEN_GAME live signal of each game with announced odds in [1.50, 2.50), registered before any result
H2.outcome: selection settled on the independent 90-minute score with the repository's own settlement rules (win, push or loss)
H2.statistic: hit rate versus mean implied probability 1/odds; units at announced odds reported only as a description
H2.decision: no claim before 200 games. No ROI validation: announced odds are not executable prices and costs are unknown

D1.definition: a registered totals signal whose direction (Over/Under) is opposite to an earlier registered totals signal of another type in the same game

evaluation_horizon: a game is evaluable once its independent outcome entry exists; analysis tables are rebuilt from the ledger at every run
integrity: append-only JSON lines; each entry carries seq, prev_sha256 and sha256 over its canonical content; duplicates of signal keys or outcome (game, provider) pairs are refused; the chain is verified before every append and a broken chain stops appends
reversal: disable the workflow step or delete the step from collect.yml; the ledger stays as evidence and is never edited
not_validated: RENTABILIDADE NÃO DEMONSTRADA — NENHUMA ESTRATÉGIA VALIDADA.
